title: MIYU Beauty & Wellbeing Reminder: Yin Yoga at 7:30pm  on 8/19/2026
description: Thank you for choosing MIYU Beauty & Wellbeing Hi Esther, Just a friendly reminder that your reservation for Yin Yoga with Juliana L. at MIYU Beauty & Wellbeing Miyu Beauty LLC on Wednesday, 8/19/2026 will start at 7:30pm . Please read the important notes below to help prepare for your class: To prep for our in-studio classes: For Yoga : Bring your own mat ($3 mat rental fee if you don't bring your own mat), towel (mainly for heated classes, we don't offer them at the studio) and water bottle (we have water fountains available to use at the studio). For Reformer Pilates : grip socks required (we sell them at the studio), and your water bottle (we have water fountains available to use at the studio). For Sound Bath : bring your own mat ($3 mat rental fee if you don't bring your own mat), we have limited props available for use at the studio but you are also welcome to bring your own props (pillow, blanket..), bring your own water bottle (we have water fountains available to use at the studio). Late Arrivals Policy : Doors will be locked 5 minutes after the start of class. For Sound Bath, meditation sessions and Yin Yoga doors will be locked promptly at the scheduled start time to minimize disruption to participants.We strongly encourage you to arrive on time. If you arrive late, your spot may be given to a waitlisted participant, and the late cancellation/ no show policy will apply.
